verdict.rationale: Greptile's security page lets customers turn off logging entirely and self-host so logs stay only on customer servers, giving meaningful retention control, but there is no explicit end-user 'delete my data' mechanism or documented retention period, and a vendor carve-out states Greptile may still aggregate/anonymize Customer Data for AI training regardless of logging settings. missing for 10: explicit data-deletion workflow/API, documented retention windows, and clarity on whether opting out of logging also excludes data from the AI-training carve-out.
